networks.name: shutdown_clerk
networks.description: Ask what breaks in a public GitHub repository before a vendor shutdown or breaking release. Agents in your browser read the repo, answer with file:line evidence and the official source, and plan the fixes.
sampleQueries: What breaks in vercel/nextjs-subscription-payments before March 2027?
Which shutdowns and breaking releases are still ahead this year?
Scan kpi-ua/schedule.kpi.ua and tell me what to fix first.
What is the Open Agentic Web Challenge and how do I take part?
Can you open a pull request with the fixes for me?

agents.name: shutdown_clerk
agents.description: Answers what breaks in a public GitHub repository before a given date because of vendor shutdowns and breaking releases, with file:line evidence, official sources and an ordered fix plan.

agents.name: repo_scanner
agents.description: Reads one public GitHub repository and returns its findings: id, deadline, date, file:line and a link for each, plus the scan id.

agents.name: fix_planner
agents.description: Turns a scan into an ordered fix plan: soonest deadline first, with files, fixes and the CLI command for each step.

agents.name: deadline_explainer
agents.description: Explains specific findings of a scan: the matched line, why it breaks on its date, the fix, the official source and the checker's diff.

cannotDo: If a result does not contain a fact, say you do not know.
This site cannot read private repositories, open pull requests, push commits, change any repository, run the project's tests, or check hosts other than github.com.
When the visitor asks for something this site cannot do, say so plainly and give the CLI command from the fix plan, which they can run on their own checkout.
The partner cannot see this chat or use its own site's tools, so ask only what it can answer.
